title: Admit one forward-only Math Discovery protocol RED readiness lineage under M8
commitMessage: chore: ready Math Discovery protocol RED development chain

contribution.summary: Make the existing M8-W01 protocol RED lineage ready for a new independently falsifiable Discovery development cycle.
contribution.value: With M8 already ready from first-pass RS284, use four target-reentrant typed ProjectPlan transitions to admit exactly M8-W01, M8-W01-C01, M8-W01-C01-T1 and its RED leaf as ready. Keep all other M8/M9 nodes not-ready and accepted product statuses planned. Adjust the two maintained C# projection validators and record a bounded new RED test contract without inferring execution or completion from prior RS131/209 portable conformance or RS279-283 package/export qualification.
debtChanges: RS284 succeeded first-pass and made only the M8 root ready; no M8 Discovery descendant was yet eligible for a new RED task cycle.
RS131/209 established the pinned thirteen-case conformance history (2 accepted, 11 refused), but that historical evidence cannot count as newly executed RED/GREEN/verification progress.
Only four existing native readiness states change; package binaries, source manifests, historic receipts, M8-W02, the rest of M8-W01 and M9 remain unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: Activate the single ready M8-W01-C01-T1-R leaf in a separate controlled run, then create fresh independent Math-owned negative protocol-drift and authority-escalation checks before further lifecycle progress.
